title: 第一卷 第13章 你家在哪指个方第一卷 第14章 说打死你就打死你
content_zh:
恩？
四目相对，二人的眉头同时皱了起来，都觉得对方过于怪异了。
顾尘觉得孟海怪，是因为对方穿得娘里娘气的，完全不像个男人。
孟海觉得顾尘怪，是因为顾尘穿得土里土气的，完全不像五家子弟。
而且！
腰里竟然挂了六只储物袋！
这么一看。
就显得顾尘又土又阔……恩？
他突然意识到了不对劲，目光重回顾尘腰间，一下盯住了其中一只储物袋！
这储物袋很特殊。
不但是合欢门独有，更是他当年亲自送给自家小师妹的定情信物！
“竟然你做的？”
一瞬间，他好似明白了什么，看了看顾尘，又看了看孟海，眼中满是惊疑错愕。
“我，找错人了？”
吴飞：“？？？”
“孟海……我……****！”
他勉强张口，含含糊糊，将此生最脏的一句话送给了对方。
破天荒的。
孟海没生他的气，因为他也觉得自己这事干得……过于草率和不讲究了。
“是你！！！”

目光一抬，杀机隐现，他盯着顾尘，一字一顿道：“是你，杀了我的小师妹？”
顾尘若有所思。
从对方的言行，从对方这不阴不阳的打扮，他已是隐隐猜出了对方的身份了。
“她要让我缩水，我就打死她，这很公平合理。”
看着对方，他认真强调道：“而且，我已经遵从她的遗愿，尽量怜惜她了。”
怜，惜？
听到这两个字，想起那一地的亵衣亵裤，皮鞭木马……孟海的眼珠子当场就红了！
你都那样……那样……还有那样了，你管这个叫怜惜？？？
“我！杀了你！”
“等……”
刚要动手，一道气若游丝的声音突然响起：“他要杀我……先……救我……”
声音。
自然来自吴飞。
此刻他根本不关心顾尘和孟海，以及那个让他蒙受了不白之冤的小师妹之间，到底有什么不为人知的故事了，他只关心他自己！
孟海那一掌太狠！
狠到当场震断了他的经脉，废掉了他的修为，让他再没了丝毫自保之力！
别说顾尘。
就算是个凡人，此时都能轻易要了他的命。
孟海眉头大皱。
有仇也就算了，没仇的情况下，他出手直接把吴飞废掉……事后还是会有麻烦的。
content_en:
kindness?
Their eyes met, and both of them frowned at the same time. They both felt that the other person was too weird.
Gu Chen felt that Meng Hai was weird because he dressed in a girly way and didn't look like a man at all.
Meng Hai thought Gu Chen was weird because Gu Chen dressed in rustic clothes and didn't look like a member of the five families at all.
and!
There are actually six storage bags hanging on the waist!
Look at it this way.
It just seems like Gu Chen is rich and earthy... Hmm?
He suddenly realized something was wrong, and looked back at Chen's waist, staring at one of the storage bags!
This storage bag is very special.
Not only is it unique to the Hehuan Sect, it is also a token of love that he personally gave to his junior sister back then!
"You actually did it?"
For a moment, he seemed to understand something. He looked at Gu Chen and then at Meng Hai, his eyes full of surprise and confusion.
"Did I find the wrong person?"
Wu Fei: "???"
"Meng Hai...I...****!"
He reluctantly opened his mouth, slurred, and gave the other party the dirtiest words in his life.
Unprecedented.
Meng Hai was not angry with him because he also felt that what he did was...too hasty and careless.
"It's you!!!"
As soon as he raised his eyes, murderous intent loomed. He stared at Gu Chen and said word by word: "Did you kill my little junior sister?"
Gu Chen was thoughtful.
From the other party's words and deeds, and from the other party's neither yin nor yang appearance, he had already vaguely guessed the other party's identity.
"If she wants me to shrink, I will beat her to death. This is fair and reasonable."
Looking at the other party, he emphasized seriously: "Besides, I have complied with her last wish and tried to pity her as much as possible."
Pity, pity?
When he heard these two words, he thought of the obscene clothes and trousers in that place, and the wooden whips... Meng Hai's eyes turned red on the spot!
You are like that...that way...and that way, you call this pity? ? ?
"Me! Kill you!"
"Wait..."
Just as he was about to take action, a voice as breathless as a gossamer suddenly sounded: "He wants to kill me...first...save me..."
sound.
Naturally from Wu Fei.
At this moment, he didn't care at all about the unknown story between Gu Chen, Meng Hai, and the little junior sister who made him suffer unfair injustice. He only cared about himself!
Meng Hai's slap was too harsh!
It was so cruel that it broke his meridians on the spot, destroyed his cultivation, and left him with no ability to protect himself!
Don't talk about Gu Chen.
Even a mortal could easily kill him at this moment.
Meng Hai frowned.
If there was any grudge, forget it. If there was no grudge, he would directly destroy Wu Fei... There would still be trouble afterwards.
